newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedbank boss likes Nordbanken, S-E merger idea.
newsitem.headline: Swedbank boss likes Nordbanken, S-E merger idea.

text.p: The chairman of Swedish bank Swedbank on Wednesday said he liked the idea of a merger between rivals Nordbanken and S-E-Banken, about which there has been much speculation.
The two banks have already held talks on a merger but earlier this year they collapsed. Analysts however expect the banks to resume discussions.

"When it comes to the Swedish banking system's ability to support the Swedish economy's growth from an international platform, the relative situation has worsened in the past 10-15 years," Swedbank chairman Goran Collert told the annual meeting.
"In this context, a merger of S-E-Banken and Nordbanken would be strategically right and good for Sweden," he said.
He said that otherwise international banks would fill the gap in the longterm.
The sector has seen much restructuring with Handelsbanken taking over mortgage lender Stadshypotek and Swedbank planning to merge with Foreningsbanken.
On Swedbank, Collert said it intended to cooperate with banks in countries around the Baltic Sea.
"An intra-Nordic vision is to work with common Nordic companies, within five to 10 years, in mortgage lending, card operations, asset management and insurance," he said.
